'''Nesker''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] a [[Balmorran resistance]] cell led by [[Zenith]] rescued the [[President/Legends|President]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] [[Retheus Galthe]] from [[Darth Lachris]]. Unfortunately, prolonged torture by Lachris broke Galthe's mind and a [[Balmorra citizens committee]] was assembled to oversee the transfer of political power to Tai Cordan, which Nesker was the first to propose.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nesker appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Consular class mission on Balmorra.
